verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships an official MCP server that works with Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients, and its homepage claims AI chat interfaces let teams "analyze, segment, and activate" customer data. However, the MCP tools it documents cover delivery debugging, pipeline monitoring, transformations, tracking plans and audit logs, not audience creation or customer-profile queries. The Audiences feature appears only as a product capability, with no documented API or MCP path for it. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools or API endpoints for querying customer/profile data, programmatic audience creation, programmatic audience activation and sync, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end flow with no dashboard.
